Chapter 915: Chapter 15: The Conduit of Space-Time (Please Subscribe)_2

…

Qianxing Immortal City.

It was still the scene of endless monstrous creatures sieging the city.

The towering Emperor of Demonic Beings had almost all opened their mouths, just waiting for the Immortal City to be breached and to devour the countless immortals inside.

But in the next moment.

The Emperor of Demonic Beings received the command from the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

They could only lead the infinite monstrous creatures to retreat and return to the Demon Abyss.

…

Chuyu Immortal City, Shaohao Immortal City, Heavenly Wheel Immortal City… in the thirty-three Immortal Domains, endless monstrous creatures led by the Emperor of Demonic Beings besieged city after city.

But at the same time.

All the monstrous creatures withdrew, even when the besieged cities were just one step away from being broken through, no Emperor of Demonic Beings dared to cross the boundary.

“What’s going on?”

“Why have all those monstrous creatures left?”

“No matter why they left, at least we don’t have to die.”

“Yes, being eaten by monstrous creatures is said to be incredibly painful, and one’s memory would be tainted.”

…

After the initial shock and confusion, the many immortals were extremely exhilarated. Who would choose to die if they could live? Especially facing such a brutal death at the maw of monstrous creatures.

“Why did the monstrous creatures retreat?”

“Was it the Ancestral Master? Did the Ancestral Master take action?”

“Our Master should not have made a move.”

“If it wasn’t the Ancestral Master who acted, then who did?”

The lords of Immortal Cities and other high-ranking titans, while relieved, also began to speculate on the reason for the monsters’ withdrawal.

The most likely speculation was that the Ancestral Master had made a move, but even the disciples of the Ancestral Master didn’t know the ins and outs of this matter.

Logically speaking, if the Ancestral Master had really acted, these disciples of the Ancestral Master would definitely have heard some rumors.

…

Cangwu Immortal City.

In front of the Grade A cave dwelling.

The lord of the Immortal City and many other high-ranking titans were respectfully waiting.

Suddenly.

The information that the endless monstrous creatures ravaging the thirty-three Immortal Domains had withdrawn reached the hands of the top Jade Immortals.

The thirty-three Immortal Domains are vast and boundless; even for mighty Jade Immortals continuously shifting through the void, it would probably take hundreds of thousands to millions of years to traverse all the domains.

But the transmission of messages is much simpler than direct walking. Through the links between causality rules, strong beings like Golden Immortals and Jade Immortals can achieve ‘instant communication.’

“All the monstrous creatures have withdrawn?”

“They withdrew on their own? Without any other powers intervening?”

“Why have all the monstrous creatures voluntarily withdrawn?”

The lord of the Immortal City and many other high-ranking titans were puzzled.

The duration of each war between immortals and demons is counted in thousands to tens of thousands of years. Nowadays, only decades have passed, and it’s still too early for the war to end.

Moreover, in past wars between immortals and demons, even when really entering the late stage and about to end, the monstrous creatures would withdraw one by one from the Immortal Realm back to the Demon Abyss.

But like now? Almost at the same time, countless monstrous creatures, including the Emperor of Demonic Beings, uniformly withdrew from the Immortal Realm, it’s more like…

It’s like they received some command.

And who has the authority to command the Emperor of Demonic Beings?

The lord of Cangwu Immortal City and other high-level giants shuddered in their hearts.

One name emerged unanimously in their minds.

Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

Besides the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, who could command the Emperor of Demonic Beings?

And such a large-scale command at that.

But why would the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss do this?

The lord of the Immortal City and many high-ranking titans exchanged glances.

Although there was no concrete evidence to prove it.

They instinctively felt that it was related to Lin Yuan’s earlier action.

Because the timing of the Emperor of Demonic Beings’ retreat was too coincidental.

They did not retreat early or late, they all withdrew just after Lin Yuan took action.

This compelled the top-tier Jade Immortals present to entertain such associations.

“Ancestor of the Demon Abyss…”

The heart of the Immortal City master was engulfed by towering waves. If their conjecture was true, it meant that the being they sought an audience with possessed the capacity to make even the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss yield.

Although an infinite number of demonic beings retreating from the Immortal Realm was not the same as the Ancestor itself yielding.

But at the very least, it indicated that the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss was apprehensive.

…

Within the cave abode.

The cultivation area.

Lin Yuan was observing everything visible to him from the perspective of the Seventh Realm of Space-Time.

Having reached an understanding of the Seventh Realm of Space-Time, Lin Yuan saw the essence of space-time unravel its mysteries across all he surveyed, comprising the space-time of Immortal Realm, the space-time of the Demon Abyss, even the space-time of this particular dimension. The endless turning of space-time is what forms a stable world where life can flourish.

Even the most mundane rock, flower, or tree is subject to the influence of space-time; should space-time collapse, these entities too would vanish.

The workings of space-time, the multitude of co-existing rules, are what shape everything stable; witnessing this, a profound emotion surfaces in Lin Yuan’s heart.

Wonderful.

Truly, incredibly wonderful.

At this moment, Lin Yuan held no more confusion. The space-time anomalies that were once beyond his understanding were now thoroughly grasped.

It was as though within the domain of space-time, Lin Yuan possessed omniscience.

“No, that’s not right.” Lin Yuan quickly regained his composure; his so-called ‘omniscience’ was merely an illusion, a misconception borne from the influx of information due to a significant leap in understanding.

In actuality, upon careful consideration, Lin Yuan realized that he was still beset with countless doubts, such as the deeper elucidations on the Seventh Realm of Space-Time within the secret skill “Milky Way”, and the descriptions of the Eighth Realm, all of which posed complex challenges to Lin Yuan.

“I’ll take it slowly.”

Lin Yuan quickly calmed himself.

“Those dozens of scouting methods just now, originating from the deepest depths of the Demon Abyss, could they be from that Ancestor of the Demon Abyss?”

Lin Yuan thought inwardly. With his current insights into space-time, he could naturally perceive the surveillance from other Second Layer beings, and was even capable of counter-surveillance and locking on targets.

“I killed six Emperor of Demonic Beings, probably alarming the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.”

Lin Yuan thought nonchalantly, without the slightest apprehension.

When he initially arrived in the Immortal Realm, towards the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, towards the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, Lin Yuan maintained utmost gravity, as they potentially posed a threat to suppress him.

But now?

The fact that the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss used dozens of scouting methods without being able to locate Lin Yuan’s true form said it all.

“To have the demons voluntarily retreat to the Demon Abyss? Quite cautious indeed.” Lin Yuan saw through the thirty-three Immortal Domains with a glance and shook his head slightly.

“They wish to meet with me?” Lin Yuan glanced outside the abode, as Yun Zhenzi had already conveyed the message of the Immortal City master and other Jade Immortals requesting an audience.

…

Upon the throne inside the cave abode.

Lin Yuan’s form appeared out of thin air and he slowly sat down.

The Cangwu Immortal City master and other high-ranking dignitaries stood respectfully below.

“We are deeply grateful for your assistance, my lord. Without you, the myriad immortals of Cangwu Immortal City…” The Cangwu Immortal City master immediately said with respect.

“It was but a casual effort.” Lin Yuan spoke calmly.

Striking at those six Emperor of Demonic Beings was solely because they disturbed his seclusion.

“And the other demonic beings from various Immortal Domains that withdrew on their own volition…” The Cangwu Immortal City master cautiously probed.

The retreat of all demonic beings had something to do with Lin Yuan, though it was merely speculation.

“That was the intention of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss,” Lin Yuan said.

This was the truth; while Lin Yuan’s power could easily crush demonic beings, including the Emperor of Demonic Beings, he did not have the authority to command them.

Only the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss had the power to orchestrate such a unified retreat of all demonic beings back to the Demon Abyss.

“The intention of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss…” The Immortal City master swallowed hard.

Although Lin Yuan did not explicitly say it, by referring to the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, his tone suggested a kind of parity.

“Right…”

Lin Yuan looked down at the petrified top-tier Jade Immortals and suddenly said: “Do me the favor of spreading the word that from today onwards, all who practice Martial Tao are under my lineage.”

The main reason Lin Yuan met with the Immortal City master and others was precisely for this matter.

For the evolutionary pathway of Martial Tao to spread thoroughly across the thirty-three realms of the Immortal Realm, it is necessary to make the immortals aware of Lin Yuan’s methods.

Having the Cangwu Immortal City master and other top-tier Jade Immortals disseminate this information is most efficient.

At least within the Xuantian Immortal Domain, the spread of the evolutionary pathway of Martial Tao would encounter no obstacles.

Having stepped into the Seventh Realm of Space-Time, Lin Yuan had no more apprehensions in this Immortal Realm and naturally sought to spread the pathway of Martial Tao.

The thirty-three realms of the Immortal Realm are vast and boundless; should Martial Tao spread here, it shall greatly aid Lin Yuan in his ultimate ascent.
